title: Tossed on the Sea of Life
description: Tossed on the Sea of Life in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904), headed “Hirmos”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Short Metre (6.6.8.6), and this page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Tossed on the sea of life, And sick and sore dis-tressed, I lift my cry to Thee, O Lord, Who giv'st the trou-bled rest.

lines: Tossed on the sea of life,
I lift my cry to Thee, O Lord,
My comrades sink to depths below,
All in a sea of sin.
Hear Thou the prayer I make,
And from the dark abyss of death

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
